info.description: The Loyalty Expiration Management API provides businesses with the capability to retrieve information about loyalty programs and their expiration statuses. This endpoint allows users to query loyalty account expiration details, ensuring customers are informed about their loyalty points and benefits. Typical consumers of this API include customer service platforms, loyalty program management systems, and marketing tools that seek to enhance customer engagement by managing loyalty program timelines effectively. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance customer retention strategies and optimize the use of loyalty rewards.

get.description: This endpoint allows for the expiration of loyalty points associated with the user. It is a crucial action for managing customer loyalty programs effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the parameters required for expiring loyalty rewards. Ensure that the request conforms to the defined schema for successful processing.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning current expiration details.
